summary: Keep terminal and runtime list reads within their latency budget without relying on an earlier agent list to warm full status history.

replay.detail: Read-side reduction only; no replay or durable claim changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers or schema version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention, replication or coordination rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Runtime and terminal resources retain the shared canonical authority and membership reducer and the same serialized fields. Full public status responses and claim fences are unchanged; internal runtime caches omit only harness state, claim provenance and desired conflicts that these resources never expose.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No manual action is required after upgrading.

recovery.detail: No migration or recovery changes; the previous binary can read the unchanged store.
